narr: Deep monsoon moisture continued to move across northern Arizona with strong to severe thunderstorms.
ev: An automated stream gauge on Cataract Creek (9 miles SSE of the Village of Supai) measured a 6 foot rise at 315 PM. A gauge near the confluence with the Colorado River showed a 1.6 foot rise starting at around 400 AM MST on July 31.
Heavy rain over the Schultz (2010) and Pipeline (2022) fire scars lead to flooding on the west end of Copeland Lane.

Heavy rain over the northern portion of the Schultz (2010) and Pipeline/Tunnel (2022) fires caused flash flooding in the Wupatki Trails neighborhood. This flooding stayed within the newly constructed channels and into the Cinder Lakes area as designed.
A thunderstorm produced heavy rain causing street flooding rendering the roads impassable.
